page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre; a catchword-like signature "Sic" at the lower right of the text block; no margin notes.

main_text.p: confidero, statim agnosco perexiguam illam & valde finitam in me esse, &c.: sola est voluntas, sive arbitrii libertas, quam tantam in me experior, ut nullius majoris ideam apprehendam: adeo ut illa præcipuè sit ratione cujus imaginem quandam & similitudinem Dei me referre intelligo: nam quamvis major absque comparatione in Deo quam in me sit, tum ratione cognitionis & potentiæ, quæ illi adjunctæ sunt, reddPlura...

page.notes: The page is damaged in places; the transcription above breaks down near "reddPlura" and is not reliable. The remaining lines (from "duntque ipsam magis firmam & efficacem" through "Sic") are to be read from the scan as follows: duntque ipsam magis firmam & efficacem, tum ratione objecti, quia ad plura se extendit, non tamen IN SE FORMALITER ET PRÆCISE spectata major videtur, quia tantum in eo consistit, quod idem vel facere vel non facere (hoc est, affirmare vel negare, prosequi vel fugere) possimus: vel potius in eo tantum quod ad id quod nobis ab intellectu proponitur affirmandum vel negandum, sive prosequendum vel fugiendum ita feramur, ut nulla vi externa nos ad id determinari sentiamus. Sic
